dns_suffix.Description: The DNS domain name suffix of the peered DNS domain.

name.Description: Name of the peered DNS domain.

network.Description: Network in the consumer project to peer with.

project.Description: The ID of the project that the service account will be created in. Defaults to the provider project configuration.

service.Description: The name of the service to create a peered DNS domain for, e.g. servicenetworking.googleapis.com
